general.description: NASA TMR 2DZP: turbulent zero-pressure-gradient flat plate, SA, M 0.2, Re 5e6 per unit length

domain.notes: TMR's nested grids (https://tmbwg.github.io/turbmodels/flatplate_grids.html), x from -1/3 to 2, plate from x = 0, top at y = 1. Not tracked: see data/grids/README.md. CD is per plate length 2, as TMR quotes it. Patches: the plate grid names none, so they are set by box: symmetry (y = 0, x < 0), wall (y = 0, x > 0), inflow (x = -1/3), outflow (x = 2), farfield (the rest).

boundary_conditions.notes: As CFL3D's input: total p and T at the inflow (1.02828, 1.008: the freestream's), p = p_inf at the outflow, symmetry ahead of the plate, Riemann invariants on top.
